status: preregistered (plan only; no build authorized, no code, no data)
process: LEAN (standing go t133s553 still needs a ledgered build_authorization_030 before any code): plan locked before data; exact false-certificate recount; strict stress gate; pre-freeze gates test on a sealed smoke block; failures published; evidence labels; one fresh-clone short verify plus tests
question: Does removing symmetry-breaking clauses from S4 and making the per-query cap hard, as S5, let exact search finish 12-state worlds that S1 cannot?
motivation: In study 029 the gated S4 matched S1 (U diff -0.019 at 12 states; GSC4 b, c FAIL). The descriptive arm S4_nosym reached U 0.079 [0.020, 0.149] and X 6/12 at 12 states, with F 0 and 0 mismatches vs S1 on 17,207 queries. That arm was seen after data, so it must be tested on fresh seeds before any claim. S4 also broke the 10.5 s query bound (15.33 s on scale16; GQB FAIL), and the inferred cause is an unchecked RegionK build or a Glucose chunk overrun

arms.S5: S4 with no symmetry-breaking clauses (S4_nosym promoted unchanged in search logic), plus a hard query cap: the region build inside a query checks the wall clock, and each solver chunk is bounded by a conflict budget sized so that a chunk cannot pass the remaining cap; a query that would pass the cap returns unknown
arms.S5_softcap: ablation: S5 with S4's soft cap (separates the cap fix from symmetry removal)

design.same_budget: 55 s per step, 10 s per query cap, as in studies 028 and 029
design.soundness: every S5 certificate rechecked by the frozen exact reference; any mismatch with S1/S4 or truth on an answered query is a FAIL

heldout_ranges.note: Fresh ranges following the study-number convention (029 used 95x0001). Disjoint from every earlier plan. Drawn only after a ledgered seedcheck_030.

cases.stress: first 3 seeds of scale8/12/16 at eps 0.05 = 9 (F only)

GSC5_headline.a: 0 mismatches of S5 vs S1/S4 and vs truth on answered queries
GSC5_headline.b: U(S5, scale12) - U(S1, scale12) <= -0.08, paired seed-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound < 0

criteria.GQB5: S5 max query time <= 10.5 s on every case
criteria.informational: S5 vs S5_softcap U difference; S5 vs S4 U difference; throughput ratios S5/S1; reported, not gated

runtime_estimate: about 1300 s on 8 workers (51 cases; 4 arms; study 029 took 1345.9 s with 5 arms)
what_counts_as_failure: any GSC5 clause failing, GQB5 above 10.5 s, or any false certificate; failures are published, not tuned
limitations: noise-free masks for the headline; eps 0.05 stress checks F only
S4_nosym's 029 result was seen before this plan; only fresh seeds test it
16-state worlds are expected to remain mostly unknown
